# Miracamp

> > Miracamp offers 1-on-1 video editing and videography courses with tutorials covering DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, and content creation for YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram.

Miracamp provides comprehensive video editing education through personalized coaching and step-by-step tutorials. The platform covers professional workflows, freelance career guidance, AI-powered content creation, and monetization strategies for aspiring video editors and content creators.

## Key Topics

- DaVinci Resolve
- Adobe Premiere Pro
- Adobe After Effects

- CapCut
- YouTube

## Courses & Training

- [Videography Course | 1-on-1 Coaching](https://www.miracamp.com/courses/videography): 1-on-1 videography course covering camera, lighting & Adobe editing tools

## DaVinci Resolve Tutorials

- [Render in DaVinci Resolve | Tutorial](https://www.miracamp.com/learn/davinci-resolve/how-to-render): DaVinci Resolve export settings tutorial for YouTube, TikTok & clients
- [Motion Tracking in DaVinci Resolve | Step-by-Step Guide](https://www.miracamp.com/learn/davinci-resolve/motion-tracking): DaVinci Resolve motion tracking in Color & Fusion panels with Power Window
- [DaVinci Resolve 20 : All New Features Explained](https://www.miracamp.com/learn/davinci-resolve/whats-new-all-new-features-explained): DaVinci Resolve 20 new features: AI Voice Convert, IntelliCut & Fusion
- [Video Stabilization & Camera Shake | DaVinci Resolve Tutorial](https://www.miracamp.com/learn/davinci-resolve/video-stabilization-and-camera-shake): Fix shaky footage & add camera shake effects in DaVinci Resolve
- [How to Crossfade Video in DaVinci Resolve](https://www.miracamp.com/learn/davinci-resolve/how-to-crossfade-video-in-davinci-resolve): Apply smooth crossfade transitions in DaVinci Resolve 20 tutorial
- [How to Change Multiple Texts in DaVinci Resolve Quickly](https://www.miracamp.com/learn/davinci-resolve/change-multiple-texts): Batch edit text elements in DaVinci Resolve using Fusion templates
